name: Asiatech Milad Tower Datacenter
notes: National datacenter inside Milad Tower, Tehran; reported at 2017 opening as >900 sqm (Tasnim B+); served as hosting site for ArvanCloud cloud servers (~7,000 cloud servers hosted there per Zoomit report B); cloud.ir is the product pivot; colocation resellers sell space at Milad Tower (C).

name: ArvanCloud Greater Tehran Region (IR-THR-AT1 and AZs)
notes: ArvanCloud runs a Greater Tehran region with 4 availability zones (2 central Tehran, 1 west, 1 east) per ISNA report (B); company states 5 datacenters in Iran after opening Qeysar in Ahvaz (peivast B); announced building one of largest datacenters in the Middle East with ~$300M investment (itjoo/Donya-e Eqtesad B); office located Kavousiyeh, Tehran (map C).

name: Chakavak Data Center (Touba), Nelson Mandela-Mirdamad
notes: Operator page: datacenter Touba in best-connected area of Tehran (Nelson Mandela-Mirdamad), 24h NOC/SOC (B); ICT ministry article highlights Chakavak as an active private-sector cloud infrastructure provider (A/B context).

name: HostIran Datacenter
notes: Operator page: Tehran datacenter, stated to be the second domestic datacenter holding the ITO datacenter-service-provider rating certificate (B; rating claim verify against ITO for A).

name: Pars Online Datacenter
notes: Operator official site advertises datacenter/colo/hosting services (B); IRNA: Pars Online among three companies granted IDC establishment license by ICT ministry (B); historically acquired by HiWEB, verify current brand/facility.

name: HiWEB Datacenter (Dadeh Gostar Asr Novin)
notes: Operator page: datacenter established on ~6,000 sqm, claiming to be the largest private-sector datacenter in Iran (B; capacity claim is operator marketing, verify rack counts separately).

name: Afranet Datacenter (first cloud datacenter)
notes: Tehran operator with colocation/dedicated server/cloud/GPU services (A for service page existence, B for capacity); Zoomit reported opening of first cloud datacenter in Iran with ICT minister (B).

name: Amin IDC (Datacenter Amin)
notes: Tehran-based commercial hosting/datacenter operator; operator tag page states it received the country's datacenter rating certificate (B; verify against ITO for A).

name: TIC Tehran national datacenter (opened with President attendance)
developer: TIC (Telecommunication Infrastructure Company) / Ministry of ICT
notes: ICT ministry news: first datacenter opened in Tehran with President attendance and second in Tabriz with Parliament speaker attendance; part of national datacenter program with satellite launch and cloud (rayaneh) projects (A).

name: Irancell / Mobinnet enterprise datacenters
notes: Mobile operators run enterprise datacenter/cloud services (official business pages, A for service existence); physical facility locations/capacity undisclosed (C for location) - record as operator DC leads.

name: ArvanCloud Bamdad Datacenter (Payam SEZ)
notes: First dedicated ArvanCloud datacenter, opened 2022-04-17 (Sovar-e Abrha event); modular 40-ft container build per Digiato (B); methodology places Bamdad in Payam Special Economic Zone (Alborz/Karaj area); roadmap covered Tehran, Tabriz, Isfahan, Shiraz, Ahvaz.

name: Shatel Payam Datacenter
notes: Shatel Business Solutions announced opening of Payam datacenter with smart cooling and UPS systems (LinkedIn announcement, C until operator official page verified); Payam naming suggests Payam SEZ area; Shatel also has Tehran/Shiraz colocation links per methodology.

name: Iran Space Agency - Alborz Space Center Datacenter
notes: Mehr News: Iran Space Agency deputy announced construction of a datacenter at the Alborz Space Center (B; planned status, not yet operational); complements Payam SEZ digital-economy development including datacenter energy planning (IRNA 86154868 B).

name: Qom Provincial Datacenter
notes: ICT ministry photo album of the Qom provincial datacenter opening (A, official); ITOI deputy announced launch of the provincial datacenter enabling hosting of government websites and acting as NIN/e-government anchor (B, SNN/Mehr).

name: Semnan Provincial Datacenter (announced)
developer: Ministry of ICT / provincial ICT directorate
notes: Semnan ICT directorate (official provincial ICT page) describes the provincial datacenter as a main component of e-government/digital economy development (B); methodology notes an official ICT opening page exists - treat status as announced/planned pending confirmed opening.

name: Qazvin Provincial Datacenter (national plan)
developer: Ministry of ICT / ITOI national provincial-datacenter plan
notes: Official Qazvin ICT national-plan page for the provincial datacenter project (official page, A-grade for plan existence; facility status planned, not confirmed operational).

name: Yazd provincial datacenter (ICT announcement, unverified)
developer: Ministry of ICT / provincial ICT directorate
notes: Methodology notes official ICT opening/announcement pages for Yazd exist; this round could not confirm an operational facility. ICT ministry article on Yazd smart city quotes that datacenters under ~300 racks are not economically viable for a city of Yazd's scale (context). Recorded as unverified lead (C).

name: Golestan Provincial Datacenter (Gorgan)
developer: Ministry of ICT / Golestan provincial ICT directorate
notes: Golestan ICT directorate (official): provincial datacenter activation will accelerate - facility exists (B/A); national ICT ministry article: Golestan ICT director visited the province's datacenter to review hosting conditions (A for existence).

name: First National Health System Backup Datacenter (Golestan)
developer: Ministry of Health / Ministry of ICT
notes: ICT ministry news: opening of the first national health-system backup datacenter in Golestan, attended by Deputy Health Minister and Golestan governor's deputy (A; government health infrastructure, not commercial colo).

name: Zanjan provincial datacenter (ICT investment, unverified)
developer: Ministry of ICT / provincial ICT directorate
notes: Methodology cites an official ICT article on investment in the Zanjan provincial datacenter; this round found no confirmation of operational stage - recorded as unverified lead (C). National datacenter program context: Tehran and Tabriz datacenters opened first (ICT 24538).

name: North Khorasan provincial datacenter (Bojnurd)
developer: Ministry of ICT / provincial ICT directorate
notes: IRNA: ICT deputy minister statement tied to a datacenter in North Khorasan connecting to NIN/ICT hubs (B); YJC: datacenter in the North Khorasan free zone planned to open by end of 12th government (B, planned lead). Verify current operational status.

name: South Khorasan (Birjand) datacenter lead
developer: Ministry of ICT / provincial ICT directorate
notes: Methodology: 2025 ICT article for Birjand covers datacenter-related equipment manufacturing plus datacenter lead; Hamshahri Online reported South datacenter colocation services soon to launch (B context, Shiraz-linked); Huawei Iran datacenter announcement by ICT minister is national context (B/C). No confirmed operational facility - unverified lead (C).
